scope: Repository-linked YouTube research source metadata and explicit third-party media reuse manifests. Neither a public URL nor a citation grants media copying permission.

publication_modes.description: Link to original source, independently authored fact summary
publication_modes.limits: No reproduction of publisher charts, graphics or full articles

publication_modes.description: Brief attributed aggregate result in original words
publication_modes.limits: Avoid reconstructing proprietary data tables, unlicensed datasets or lengthy text
Quote-length and legal context must be inspected manually; automatic counting is not a safe harbor

publication_modes.description: Copied image, chart, photograph, screenshot, source video or audio
publication_modes.limits: Needs actual license/permission and attributable creator, source, license and adaptations as appropriate

publication_modes.description: Mercata-built chart from properly attributable and permitted public aggregates
publication_modes.limits: Original design does not solve source-data licensing or misleading units

source_record_quality: All current registered sources are required to supply publisher/title, retrieval date, a human-readable license/reuse note, and HTTPS source address. These source-level notes are not actual license grants.
manifest_completeness: Unknown pending a manual byte/file audit. Empty list must not be used to assert repository contains no external-media reuse.
review_workflow: Enumerate all published media, copied text, downloaded datasets and embedded external visual assets, including generated thumbnails and hidden metadata.
Distinguish linked external material from a local copy or a derived visual.
Check creator/owner attribution, original source URL and applicable license or permissions when actually reusing copyrighted assets.
Check CC TASL elements only for CC-licensed works; do not label commercial Help pages or news photos as CC-licensed without evidence.
Verify research aggregate source terms separately from visual and raw dataset rights; a short attributed statistic is not proof that the underlying dataset can be redistributed.
Review quote lengths, copyright context, attribution, translation, charts and publisher license updates manually.
Require rights-specific reviewer signoff before publishing any new third-party asset; never import private materials or personal financial records.
